_doc: DayZero app catalog. Modes in modes.json list ids from here.
winget:    the exact winget package id. Each id below was checked against Microsoft's winget-pkgs
repository on 2026-11-12. At install time DayZero runs 'winget show --id <id> --exact'
first; if the id no longer exists it runs 'winget search' and logs what it found.
tools\Test-DzAppIds.ps1 (or 'Check app list' in the builder) re-checks every id.
elevated:  false = install as the signed-in user without admin rights. Needed for installers that
refuse admin (Spotify) or install per user (Discord, so it is not started as admin).
scope:     optional 'machine' or 'user', passed to winget --scope.
optional:  true = shown unticked on the review screen (for the modes listed in 'modes').
